# The old route in a new year

Rode the canal path again and found the diversion removed. My printed map was now the obstacle. Mark temporary notes with a review date. [[Routes]] should retain the photograph of the steps as evidence of the interruption, while the current route can say the entrance is open. An archive and a guide have different obligations.
